# Portly

Portly is an open-source native macOS supervisor for local development servers.

It gives humans and AI coding agents one source of truth for project commands, ports, process IDs, health, logs, and ownership. Portly exposes a native app, a command-line interface, and a loopback-only HTTP API.

- Website: https://portly.melvynx.dev
- Source: https://github.com/Melvynx/portly
- License: MIT
- Platform: macOS 14 or newer
